_meta.name: partial_correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Partial correlation matrices on training_data.pulse: price, income and label with each pair held fixed for the third (params.control "all", the precision-matrix partials), and price against income with label held fixed through a control list (label sits outside the fields, so it joins the fold and the missing-data mode, and the output covers price and income only). A pairwise input that is not positive semidefinite is refused with PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_PSD unless params.repair is "nearest"; collinear fields are PULSE_MATRIX_SINGULAR. Streamable and mergeable; no p-values.
